tasks.label: stash-grasshopper-libraries
tasks.command: LIB="$HOME/Library/Application Support/McNeel/Rhinoceros/8.0/Plug-ins/Grasshopper (b45a29b1-4343-4035-989e-044e8580d9cf)/Libraries/UR.RTDE.Grasshopper"; DISABLED="${LIB}.disabled-by-debug"; if [ -d "$LIB" ] && [ ! -d "$DISABLED" ]; then mv "$LIB" "$DISABLED" && echo "Stashed Libraries copy -> $(basename "$DISABLED")"; elif [ -d "$DISABLED" ]; then echo "Libraries copy already stashed"; else echo "No Libraries copy to stash"; fi

tasks.label: restore-grasshopper-libraries
tasks.command: LIB="$HOME/Library/Application Support/McNeel/Rhinoceros/8.0/Plug-ins/Grasshopper (b45a29b1-4343-4035-989e-044e8580d9cf)/Libraries/UR.RTDE.Grasshopper"; DISABLED="${LIB}.disabled-by-debug"; if [ -d "$DISABLED" ]; then rm -rf "$LIB" 2>/dev/null; mv "$DISABLED" "$LIB" && echo "Restored Libraries copy"; else echo "Nothing to restore"; fi
